remarks: Walking distance to everything Darien has to offer! Conveniently located to downtown, the new Corbin District with shops, restaurants, train station and I95. Charming 2 bedroom/1 full bath half duplex with new flooring, ample off-street parking, new appliances, washer/dryer, energy efficient windows and freshly painted inside and out. Ready to move in with tons of natural light. Storage available in the basement. Tenant responsible for credit check, 2 months security (1 month if 62 or older) and 1st month rent, all utilities including electricity, heat (oil), hot water, internet/cable, trash collection and personal and liability insurance. No smoking. One cat would be considered. Incredible value in a must see location!
